artworks.title: George Washington
artworks.description: The painting is a portrait of a man from the waist up. He is slightly turned to the left. He has pale skin, a long nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips set in a neutral expression. He has pale gray hair styled back from his face. He is wearing a military uniform with a dark blue coat, yellow lapels, gold buttons, and gold epaulettes. A white cravat is tied around his neck. The background is a gradient of brown and gray, darker near the edges of the painting and lighter around the man.

artworks.title: Abraham Lincoln
artworks.description: This painting shows a man facing the right. He has pale skin, a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, high cheekbones, a wrinkled brow, dark eyebrows, and a small mole near his mouth, which is set in a neutral expression. There is a hint of purple under his eye. The man has a thick beard and short, dark brown hair. He is dressed in formal attire, with a dark suit over a white collared shirt, and black bow tie. The background is black.

artworks.title: Sarah Blake Sturgis
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman facing forward, slightly angled to her left. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark eyes, red lips, and brown curly hair. She wears a teal dress with a lace scarf, and a teal headband. The background is a dark solid color.

artworks.title: A Painter and Visitors in a Studio
artworks.description: This painting depicts a group of people gathered in a room. Two men are seated, with one reading papers and the other holding a palette and paint brushes. Several standing people are gathered around these seated people, including a variety of men and women dressed in long, brightly-colored gowns or suits and jackets. Near the center a woman is holding a baby. All of the people have pale skin and most have brown hair, except for one man with gray hair. In the background, there is a large canvas or easel. On the wall on the right, there are three paintings, one of which is framed. The room's walls are decorated in muted tones of pale green, brown, and yellow. The brushstrokes of the background are thick and visible.

artworks.title: Maria Gansevoort Melvill (Mrs. Allan Melvill)
artworks.description: This painting depicts a seated woman from the waist up. She has her right elbow resting on one arm of the red chair that she sits in, with her head leaning on her hand. Her left hand is holding white fabric in her lap. She has light skin, blue eyes, a large nose, and pink lips set in a slight smile. Her curly brown hair is styled up with a decorative headband featuring a crescent-shaped ornament. She wears a dark dress with a lace-trimmed neckline, short, puffed sleeves, a gold brooch, and gold earrings. The background is warm brown with a reddish fabric draped on the right side.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Gentleman
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated in a large blue chair. He is dressed in a golden-brown silk robe, holding a closed book in his lap. The man has a neutral expression and his gaze is directed towards the viewer. He has a broad forehead, light eyebrows, and gray curly hair that falls to his shoulders. The background includes architectural elements like a column on the right side.

artworks.title: Maria Hamilton Beckford (Mrs. William Beckford)
artworks.description: This painting shows a seated woman, her head turned slightly to the right. She has fair skin with rosy cheeks, pale eyebrows, a long nose, and thin pink lips in a neutral expression. Her dark brown hair is in an updo behind her head and adorned with blue ribbons and pearls, and she has a pearl necklace around her neck. She is wearing a dark blue dress with lace details around the low neckline and the wide sleeves. She holds a large open book with a yellow cover on her lap, and there is a guitar-like instrument leaning next to her on the right. On the left is draping red fabric and a cascade of colorful flowers. Behind her in the distance are large, off-white buildings with tall columns and railings, and behind the buildings is a green hill covered with peacocks and leafy trees. The blue sky above is scattered with puffy white and gray clouds.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a man's body. He is facing slightly to the left with his head turned towards the viewer, in a formal pose. The man has light-colored skin, rosy cheeks, and a calm expression. His hair is styled in a manner typical of the 18th century, with curls and tied back away from his face. He wears a dark coat with visible buttons and a white cravat around his neck. The cravat is slightly ruffled and tucked into his coat. There is no visible jewelry or objects in his hands. The background is plain, with subtle gradations of brown and dark green shades.

artworks.title: A Military Officer
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man's upper body, from the waist up. He is slightly angled to the left, with his gaze forward. The man has fair skin and a calm expression. His white hair is styled in 18th-century curls. He wears a military uniform with a black undershirt, white waistcoat, and red outer coat with gold details. A black cravat is around his neck. His right hand is inside his coat. The background is a plain, muted brown color.

artworks.title: Thomas Dawson, Viscount Cremorne
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dark suit with a white cravat, sitting and facing slightly to his right. He has light brown curly hair, fair skin, light blue eyes, a straight nose, and a subtle smile. The background is a red drapery with books stacked horizontally partially hidden behind it, and the man is illuminated against this backdrop.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The image displays a portrait of a woman with fair complexion, featuring a distinctive nose and a subtle smile. She has light-colored, neatly styled hair with a ribbon or band. The woman wears a golden-yellow gown with white lace trim and a pink ribbon on her bodice. There is a hint of blue fabric near her waist, and she wears an earring on her left ear. The background is dark, focusing on the woman in the foreground.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person facing the viewer with their body slightly turned. The individual has curly, shoulder-length hair and distinct facial features including a prominent nose, slightly pursed lips, and a straight gaze. They are wearing a dark garment with white lace at the collar and cuffs. The person is holding an object in their left hand, partially obscured. The background features darker shades, possibly foliage or textured surfaces, with greenery on the right side and a hint of sky or clouds on the left. The painting shows signs of aging like fading and cracking of the paint.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image displays a chest-up portrait of a person gazing directly at the viewer. The individual has a defined jawline, high cheekbones, and dark, slightly arched eyebrows. Their light brown hair is moderately long and voluminous. They are wearing a dark coat with a high collar and a white ruffled cravat around the neck and upper chest. The background is dark and plain, emphasizing the subject's appearance and clothing.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man seated, showing the upper half of his body. He has dark brown hair, fair skin with a warm undertone, a straight nose, thin lips, and pronounced cheekbones. He wears formal attire including a dark suit with a double-breasted waistcoat, a white high-collared shirt, and a black cravat tied in a bow. His right hand rests on the arm of a red upholstered chair. The background is a simple soft brown gradient.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He stands slightly to the right but faces forward, making direct eye contact. The man has a fair complexion with a reddish hue on his cheeks and a broad face. His hair is short, dark brown, and receding from the forehead. He wears a dark double-breasted coat with large buttons and a white cravat around his neck. His right hand is visible holding onto what appears to be a walking stick or cane. In the background, there is a dark draped cloth on the left side, and beside this, the spine of a book, part of a small bookshelf, can be seen. The overall background is dark, emphasizing the figure in the portrait.

artworks.title: Phoebe Cassidy Freeman (Mrs. Clarkson Freeman)
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a woman with fair skin, light blue eyes, and dark brown hair styled in an updo. She wears a dark gown with long sleeves and a white collar, with a simple background.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman seated, facing slightly to the side with her gaze directed towards the viewer. She has soft, delicate skin and a calm expression. Her hair is styled in an updo with loose curls. She is wearing a blue dress with white lace, puffed sleeves, and a golden-orange shawl draped across her chest. She is holding an open book, with one hand resting on a surface. The chair has a red fabric with subtle patterns, and the background is a dark, warm-toned wall.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a man's body. He is positioned facing slightly to his left while looking directly at the viewer. The man has a fair complexion with soft facial features, including clear eyes and a slight smile. His hair is dark, wavy, and styled with a gentle wave atop his head. He is dressed in a formal black coat over a white shirt, featuring a high collar. The background of the image is a dark, solid color. No jewelry or objects are visible in the painting.

artworks.title: Junius Brutus Booth
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and upper part of the torso of a person. The person is positioned with the upper body slightly turned to the side while gazing forward. They have a youthful face with prominent facial features, including deep-set eyes and a straight nose, accompanied by dark, curly hair framing their face. The individual is dressed in a garment that appears to have a dark, textured shawl or wrap over a lighter shirt, visible around the neck area. The background is a plain, dark brown.

artworks.title: Dr. James Hall
artworks.description: The image depicts a man from the waist up. He is positioned slightly to the side and looking away from the viewer. He has a prominent jawline, large sideburns, and curly, short brown hair. The man is dressed in formal attire, wearing a dark suit jacket over a white shirt with a high collar, potentially with a dark waistcoat and a bowtie. There are no visible jewelry or objects held. The background features a textured mix of brown and earthy tones, creating a neutral and classic setting.

artworks.title: Dr. John Edwards Holbrook
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of an older man, visible from the chest upward, in a seated position, facing left in profile. His facial features include a strong, prominent nose, a firm chin, and a subtle expression with closed lips. His hair is gray, short, and brushed neatly backward. He is wearing a formal dark suit with a white shirt and a black bow tie. The background is a simple, warm-toned brown, free from any additional objects or details. There is no jewelry visible, and he does not appear to be holding anything.
